title: The explicit affine-resolution cochain complex
statement: For a scheme Y [def-pc-scheme], an affine open U, and a nonnegative chain complex K of modules over Γ(Y,U) [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology], define its cochain complex on the localized open site by termwise associated sheaf, affine-chart restriction, extension by zero along n ↦ -n, and termwise application of the inverse of Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U. No existence theorem chooses the complex.
